title: Downloads
sub: What is downloading, what is done and where nexcrate needs you. The list refreshes every 5 seconds.

waiting.intro: nexcrate would load these releases but is still waiting: the delay rule of their version gives a better release some time. Once the time is up, the best release known by then loads by itself.
waiting.emptyHint: Releases only wait when a version has a waiting time. From the factory none has one.
waiting.due: Time is up, loads on the next pass
waiting.dueButOff: Time is up, but the automatic is off: loads once it is on, or with Load now

blocklist.intro: nexcrate does not take these releases any more. A failed download blocks its release by itself, so the search does not fetch the same broken file again.

summary.text: Under Problems each one says what is going on and what you can do.

clients.none: No download client yet. Without one nexcrate cannot download anything.
clients.failing: {{name}}: {{text}} Its downloads stay as they are until it answers again.

active.title: Downloading
active.intro: The files download in your download clients. As soon as they are done, nexcrate picks them up and stores them in the folder of their title.
active.empty: Nothing is downloading right now. You download a release on the page of a movie or a series, after a search.

problems.empty: No download needs help right now.

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.intro: nexcrate cannot go on here without you. Each card says what is going on and offers the next step.

hints.title: Hints
hints.intro: nexcrate takes care of these itself, or they are already dealt with. You can step in if you like.

reason.path_not_found: The download is done, but nexcrate cannot find the files under the path {{client}} reports.
reason.packed: The download only holds packed files.
reason.no_video: The download holds no video file.
reason.no_space: There is not enough free space where the file should go.
reason.gone_from_client: The download has disappeared, {{client}} does not know it any more.
reason.client_error: For this download, {{client}} reports an error.
reason.import_failed: Something went wrong while storing it.
reason.dangerous_file: The download held a dangerous file.
reason.encrypted: The download holds an archive with a password.
reason.stalled: Nobody is sharing the file right now.
reason.unknown: Something is wrong with this download.
reason.files_unassigned: nexcrate could not safely assign some files to an episode.
reason.other_series_suspected: The files are named like another series.
reason.several_videos: The download holds several videos of a similar size.
reason.import_stalled: Filing away has not moved on for 30 minutes.
reason.too_many_files: The download has too many files.
reason.album_single_file: The album came as one file with a cue sheet.
reason.album_not_better: The new files are not better than those there.
reason.album_tracks_missing: The album's track lists are still missing.
reason.download_failed: The download failed. {{client}} gave it up.
reason.file_truncated: A video in the download is cut off.
reason.file_truncatedEpisodes: The video for {{episodes}} is cut off.

why.pathProposal: nexcrate and {{client}} see the same folder under different paths. nexcrate found the download under its own folders and suggests a mapping.
why.pathNoProposal: nexcrate did not find it under its own folders either. Is the download folder mounted in the nexcrate container?
why.packed: nexcrate does not unpack yet. Remove the download and take another release.

packedReason.unsupported: nexcrate cannot unpack this kind of archive.
packedReason.incomplete: A part of the archive is missing.
packedReason.unsafe: The archive holds paths or links that lead out of the folder. nexcrate does not unpack it.
packedReason.nested: The archive holds another archive. nexcrate unpacks only one level.
packedReason.too_large: The archive would give too many or too large files.

why.encrypted: nexcrate blocked the release. Remove the download.
why.no_video: The release is probably incomplete. Remove the download and take another release.
why.no_space: Free up some space and then try again.
why.gone_from_client: Maybe it was deleted there. Remove it here and take another release.
why.client_error: This is often not the release's fault, for example with a full disk. Check what {{client}} says about it and remove the download if it does not move on.
why.import_failed: The log has the details. You can try again.
why.destinationExists: Another file already has the target name. nexcrate does not overwrite it. Move or delete it, then try again.
why.dangerous_file: nexcrate refused the download and blocked the release.
why.client_unreachable: The download stays as it is. nexcrate keeps asking.
why.stalled: The download goes on as soon as someone shares.
why.other_series_suspected: nexcrate stores nothing, so no other series ends up under this one. Check the files and assign them by hand.
why.several_videos_other: {{count}} videos. Choose the one to file.
why.multi_part: nexcrate files no half movies and has blocked the release.
why.import_stalled: nexcrate may have restarted while storing. Try again.
why.too_many_files: nexcrate reads at most 2,000 videos and 10,000 files per download.
why.files_unassigned: {{filed}}, {{open}}. Assign them by hand or leave the rest.
why.unknownNumbers: The pack counts differently than TMDB: {{codes}} do not exist there. So nexcrate stores nothing by itself. Assign the files by hand.
why.countedOtherwise: The files count by {{scheme}}, not as assumed when loading. nexcrate stored only what surely fits that way. Assign the rest by hand or leave it.
why.foreignFile: The season folder already holds a video for {{episodes}} that nexcrate does not know. nexcrate puts no second file next to it. Move or delete it, then try again, or leave the rest.

importReason.no_folder: The version has no folder. Choose one in the settings, then try again.
importReason.folder_not_writable: nexcrate may not write in the folder of the version. Check the permissions, then try again.
importReason.folder_not_visible: nexcrate does not see the folder of the version. Check that it is mounted in the container, then try again.
importReason.version_gone: The version is gone. Remove the download.
importReason.version_fed_by_source: A connection such as Sonarr or Radarr feeds this version. nexcrate stores nothing there. Remove the download.
importReason.transfer_failed: The file could not be moved, copied or linked. The log has the details. You can try again.
importReason.database_busy: The database was busy for half an hour; nexcrate tried again and again. Try once more; if it stays like this, restarting nexcrate helps.

why.no_audio: Neither audio files nor archives with music. nexcrate filed nothing; remove the download and search again.
why.album_single_file: nexcrate does not cut such albums into tracks yet. The release is blocked; search for another one.
why.album_not_better: nexcrate replaces an album only when neither quality nor the count of tracks gets worse. Nothing was touched; you can replace anyway or file nothing more.
why.album_tracks_missing: Without MusicBrainz's track lists nexcrate maps no file. It waited for a day.
why.albumUnassigned: {{filed}}, {{open}} open, {{missing}} without a file. Assign the open files or file nothing more.
why.download_failed: Three replacements were tried today already, and the automatic is off. Search another release yourself, or take the card away with “Done”.
why.file_truncated: The file is shorter than its content says. nexcrate did not file it, and a file already there stays as it is. Remove the download and take another release.

problems.cleared: The failed download is in the history only now.

mapping.title: Take the mapping
mapping.intro: When {{client}} reports a path under {{remote}}, nexcrate will look for it under {{local}}.
mapping.scope: This applies to every download {{client}} reports. nexcrate files this download away right after.

remove.title: Remove download?
remove.text: The download disappears from nexcrate. Files nexcrate has already stored stay.
remove.fromClient: Also remove it in {{client}} and delete the downloaded files
remove.fromClientHint: Otherwise {{client}} keeps downloading or keeps the download. Anything nexcrate has not stored yet is gone afterwards.
remove.blocklistHint: Then nexcrate only downloads this release for the title after asking you.

history.title: History
history.intro: Downloads that were stored, failed or removed, newest first.

transfer.hardlink: Shares the file with the torrent, no extra space.

failed.client_failed: The download failed, as {{client}} reports. nexcrate blocked the release.
failed.encrypted: The release was protected with a password. nexcrate blocked it.
failed.not_taken: {{client}} did not take the release in time and never showed it later. The release is not blocked.

history.skippedCodes: left out, the file there is not worse: {{codes}}

detail.incomplete: {{client}} says: parts are missing on the server, the download cannot finish.
detail.not_on_server: {{client}} says: the server does not have the files (any more).
detail.password: {{client}} says: the archive needs a password.
detail.unwanted_extension: {{client}} says: the release held an unwanted kind of file.
detail.duplicate: {{client}} says: the release was there before.
detail.other: {{client}} gave a reason nexcrate does not know. It is in the history of {{client}}.

aftermath.kept_file: No better release found, the file there stays.
aftermath.waiting_limit: A better release waits for the indexer's daily limit. nexcrate loads it from {{at}}.
aftermath.waitingLimitSoon: A better release waits for the indexer's daily limit. nexcrate loads it as soon as there is room again.
aftermath.nothing_found: Nothing fitting found yet. nexcrate keeps searching on schedule, next on {{at}}.
aftermath.nothingFoundLater: Nothing fitting found yet. nexcrate keeps searching on schedule.
aftermath.searching: nexcrate searches another release in a moment.
aftermath.schedule: Three replacements were tried today already. nexcrate searches on schedule again.
aftermath.owner: nexcrate does not search on by itself. The card under Problems says what you can do.

assign.title: Assign {{release}}
assign.sourceOnly: Specials TMDB does not know cannot be assigned.
assign.twice: {{codes}} is chosen for more than one file. If they are two halves of one episode, choose part 1 for one and part 2 for the other.
assign.notBetterTitle: Not better than the file there
assign.notBetter_one: The chosen file is not better than the file {{episodes}} has. That file would go to the recycle bin.
assign.notBetter_other: {{value}} chosen files are not better than the files {{episodes}} have. Those files would go to the recycle bin.
assign.allCovered: Every episode of this download has a file or is chosen.
assign.unreadableHint_one: {{value}} file has no readable name, so nexcrate does not know which episode it is. Choose it yourself, or fill in the free episodes in order and check them before storing.
assign.unreadableHint_other: {{value}} files have no readable names, so nexcrate does not know which episodes they are. Choose them yourself, or fill in the free episodes in order and check them before storing.
assign.useProposals: Fill in free episodes in order
assign.otherSeriesHint: The files are named like another series, so nothing is chosen yet. If it is this series after all, the button takes over the numbers read. Check them before storing.
assign.unknownHint: The pack counts differently than TMDB: {{codes}} do not exist there. So a number that fits may be another episode. Check every assignment before storing.
assign.countedHint: The files count by {{scheme}}, not as assumed when loading. nexcrate read them that way. Check every assignment before storing.
assign.openHint: Files without an episode stay open. You can assign them later or leave the rest.
assign.coversMore: The file there also holds {{codes}}. Choose those episodes as well, or it stays.

decision.duplicate: Twice: another file of this download has this episode.
decision.not_needed: Belongs to no episode of this download.
decision.skipped: Left out: the file there is not worse.

choose.title: Choose file
choose.intro: Which video of {{release}} should be filed?
choose.done: The chosen file is being filed.

finish.title: Leave the rest?
finish.again: They come up again at the next search.
finish.usenet: {{client}} then deletes the download with the remaining files.
finish.torrent: The torrent stays in {{client}} and keeps seeding.
finish.album: What is not filed stays without a file. The album's target release does not change.

albumAssign.title: Assign by hand: {{album}}
albumAssign.notBetter: There now: {{before}}, {{tracksBefore}} tracks of the target release. New: {{after}}, {{tracksAfter}} tracks. Replacing puts every old file into the recycle folder.
albumAssign.releaseHint: How nexcrate takes the files. Another release changes the track list.
albumAssign.releaseFixed: Files of this download lie in the album folder already; the release stays.
albumAssign.placedAs: Lies in the album folder as {{code}}.
albumAssign.placedLoose: Lies in the album folder without a track.
albumAssign.onlyThis: The choice holds for this download only; the album's target release stays.
albumAssign.twice: A track is chosen more than once: {{codes}}.
albumAssign.looseHint: Filed under its own name, a hidden track or a medley for example.

foreign.title: Not ordered by nexcrate
foreign.intro: These jobs lie in nexcrate's category, but nexcrate did not order them. nexcrate never files them by itself: assign them to a movie or remove them.
foreign.removeText: The job leaves {{client}}, with its files. This cannot be undone.
foreign.dialogIntro: nexcrate files the job as if it had ordered it itself: into the folder of the version, with its naming. When the version has a file, the old one goes into the recycle bin.
foreign.nothingInLibrary: Nothing found in the library. Add the title first.
foreign.noVersion: This title has no version yet. Add one first.
foreign.seriesHint: nexcrate files the episodes the name names, for a season pack the whole season. What it cannot place, it asks you as usual.
